why_it_matters: Enabled local admin accounts provide cluster-admin kubeconfig credentials through the Azure management API to anyone with Azure RBAC contributor access.
Attackers with subscription-level read or action permissions can invoke listClusterAdminCredentials to bypass Entra ID authentication and auditing.
Disabling local accounts forces all Kubernetes API interactions through centralized identity providers and Azure RBAC role assignments.
post_en:
AKS clusters with local accounts enabled allow anyone with Azure RBAC access to retrieve static cluster-admin kubeconfig files.
Set local_account_disabled to true on azurerm_kubernetes_cluster to force all cluster access through Microsoft Entra ID.
This blocks attackers from extracting cluster-admin credentials via the ARM API and bypassing conditional access policies.
CKV_AZURE_141 fails the first version and passes the second.
